significance: An 11th-century Chola temple near Tiruvarur with a five-tiered rajagopuram, honoured in the Tevaram hymns of Appar and counted among the 275 Paadal Petra Sthalams.
story: A Shaiva woman whose husband smashed her linga worshipped a carpenter's wedge instead; when he swung an axe at it, Shiva manifested from the wedge, giving the deity his name.
